title: CortexOps
summary: An AI-powered incident resolution proof-of-concept for IT support teams that uses agent-based RAG over synthetic ServiceNow incidents and knowledge base articles for a Merchant Onboarding scenario. Synthetic data is generated by SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to create the demo incident and KB datasets.
evidence: synthesize_kb.py:9-13 imports SingleTableMetadata and CTGANSynthesizer; line 44 instantiates CTGANSynthesizer(metadata=metadata)
